===grep gitignore===
74:config/runtime/*.local.vars
84:config/runtime/acceptance-hb.vars
85:config/runtime/base.vars
86:config/runtime/local-builder.vars
87:config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars
88:config/runtime/studio.vars
===check-ignore===
.gitignore:85:config/runtime/base.vars	config/runtime/base.vars
.gitignore:87:config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars	config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars
===tracked runtime files===
config/runtime/dev.vars.example
config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars.example
config/runtime/public-waste.vars.example
config/runtime/remote/dev.vars
config/runtime/remote/prod.vars
config/runtime/remote/staging.vars

config/runtime/studio.vars.example

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "===grep gitignore===" && grep -n "config/runtime" .gitignore; echo "===check-ignore==="; git check-ignore -v config/runtime/base.vars config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars; echo "===tracked runtime files==="; git ls-files config/runtime/ | head; echo "===exit done==="
